title: Return Request Flow
content: Build return request flow. Order selection: list of eligible items from recent orders, select items to return. Reason: dropdown (Too small, Too large, Changed mind, Defective, Wrong item). Condition: confirm item is unworn/unused. Resolution: refund or exchange option. Summary: return shipping info, refund timeline. Confirmation: return label and instructions.

variants.simple: Create return request form with reason selection and instructions.
variants.detailed: Build return request flow. Order selection: list of eligible items from recent orders, select items to return. Reason: dropdown (Too small, Too large, Changed mind, Defective, Wrong item). Condition: confirm item is unworn/unused. Resolution: refund or exchange option. Summary: return shipping info, refund timeline. Confirmation: return label and instructions.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive return request flow as multi-step process. Entry points: "Start Return" in order history, "Return Item" per item in order detail, dedicated returns page. Step 1 - Select Order: if not pre-selected, show eligible orders list (within return window), each order shows: date, order number, item count, thumbnail images of items, "Not eligible" badge for orders outside window. Step 2 - Select Items: display all items from order, checkbox per item to select for return, each item: image, name, variant, original quantity, return quantity selector (if bought multiple), eligibility status (eligible, final sale, past window). Step 3 - Return Reason: for each selected item, reason dropdown (Size too small, Size too large, Changed my mind, Damaged/Defective, Wrong item received, Item not as described, Better price found, Other), free-text field for details especially if Defective/Other, optional photo upload for defective claims. Step 4 - Item Condition: checkboxes confirming items are: unused/unworn, in original packaging, all tags attached, not final sale, warning if conditions not met about potential rejection. Step 5 - Resolution preference: refund to original payment method (show amount), refund to store credit/gift card (often processed faster), exchange for different size/color (if available), bonus incentive for store credit ("Get 10% bonus as store credit"). Step 6 - Return Method: prepaid shipping label (deducted from refund or free), drop off at partner location (list nearby locations), schedule pickup (premium option), in-store return (if applicable), QR code for label-free return at supported carriers. Step 7 - Review: summary of return request showing all selections, expected refund amount and timeline ("Refund processed within 3-5 business days of receipt"), terms and conditions checkbox. Confirmation page: return confirmation number, return label (download/print/email options), QR code if applicable, packing instructions, list of return steps, tracking link, estimated refund timeline. Email: send confirmation with all details and label. Return tracking: status updates (Return Initiated, In Transit, Received, Processing, Refund Issued), notification emails at each stage. Return history: list of past returns with status. Mobile: step indicator, mobile-optimized form controls. Accessibility: multi-step progress communicated, form fields properly labeled.
